title: Isomorphisms in the unbounded derived category detected by cohomology
statement: Let $\mathcal A$ be an abelian category [def-sp-abelian] and let $D(\mathcal A)$ be its unbounded derived category in a chosen universe [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. For every morphism $f:K\to L$ in $D(\mathcal A)$, $f$ is an isomorphism if and only if $H^n(f):H^n(K)\to H^n(L)$ is an isomorphism in $\mathcal A$ for every $n\in\mathbf Z$.
